run_gpt2_evaluation: run the GPT2 model evaluation script on validation data with distributed training support
build_gpt2_model: build a GPT2 model with configurable layers, hidden size, and attention heads for language modeling
create_lm_eval_dataset: create a language model evaluation dataset from tokenized text with configurable sequence length and padding
create_lambada_eval_dataset: create a LAMBADA cloze evaluation dataset from JSONL text files with strict or relaxed tokenization
evaluate_model_and_print_results: evaluate a GPT2 model on validation data and print perplexity or accuracy results
